name: Doorstep Services
description: Provides a platform for customers to register for doorstep services.
library_dependencies: tecnickcom/tcpdf (external PHP library, required at runtime by the PDF bill generator; instantiated directly as \TCPDF in PdfGeneratorService — not declared in a composer.json, must be installed separately)
project_description: Doorstep Services is a lightweight request-and-track workflow for at-home ("doorstep") service businesses, built entirely on core node storage rather than a dedicated entity. On install (hook_install in doorstep_services.install) it creates two content types — Service Provider (service_provider) and Service Request (service_request) — and attaches six fields to service_request: field_service_type (list_string), field_status (list_string: pending/in_progress/completed/cancelled), field_contact_number (string), field_customer_email (email), field_notes (text_long) and field_preferred_time (datetime). Customers submit requests through a public form at /doorstep-services/register (RequestForm), which creates a service_request node and sends confirmation email to the customer plus a notification to the site admin via hook_mail. Customers view their own requests at /user-requests (DoorstepServicesUserRequestsController, rendered through the doorstep_services_user_requests theme hook/Twig template) and can edit (DoorstepServiceRequestEditForm) or cancel (DoorstepServicesCancelForm) them. Administrators (routes gated by 'administer site configuration') manage all requests at /admin/service-requests (ServicesController::viewRequests) with a status filter (DoorstepServicesFilterForm), update a request's status (StatusUpdateForm), bulk-delete requests (BulkDeleteForm), and, when a request is marked completed, enter a price (PriceEntryForm) that drives PdfGeneratorService to build a TCPDF PDF bill emailed to both the customer and the admin. Depends on core node, user and views; email delivery expects the contributed SMTP module and PDF generation requires the tecnickcom/tcpdf library. Not covered by Drupal's security advisory policy.
